descriptionChirho: A combustible mineral substance (sulfur/brimstone) associated in Scripture with divine judgment and catastrophic destruction. Used of the rain upon Sodom (Gen 19:24), the punishment of the wicked (Job 18:15, Ps 11:6), and prophetic imagery of God's consuming fire (Isa 30:33, 34:9, Ezek 38:22). All multilingual glosses uniformly point to the same chemical substance: Arabic kibrIt, Hindi gandhak, Korean yuhwang, Spanish azufre.
